sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.detail: one sentence, from memory, written before document work
sections.markdown: What I believe the market narrative is: QCOM is a MediaTek-share-loss / handset-softness story in decline, and the big 6-month move is an AI-narrative bounce (partly short-cover) that the weakening handset/licensing base cannot sustain.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** the handset + licensing franchise is structurally fading (Android share grab, Samsung-modem lead loss), so the recent run is a momentum bounce; the re-test of the prior high fails and the margin trough proves the model broke.

**Why wrong:** three fundamentals the tape under-weights. (1) The FY26 handset fade is a mid-cycle trough, not terminal: TTM handset $25.9B sits under FY25's $27.79B, but Automotive (+36% FY25; TTM $5.07B) and IoT (+22%; TTM $7.05B) carry revenue, and QTL's single largest overhang — the Apple global patent license — was renewed effective 2027-04-01, a licensing-clarity event inside this 9-month window. (2) The Q3 FY26 margin trough (16.4% op vs 26.6% a year ago, 10-Q) is the opex pivot (layoffs, restructuring) hitting the P&L, not a proven model break — a one-off aeroplane; 27% op is recoverable without a new handset share win. (3) The data-center/AI entry (AWS deal) is optionality for the multiple, not yet revenue to the valuation — but its existence caps the pure handset-only bear case. Edge taxonomy: **(a) analytical** — the market reads the margin trough as structural; it is a compressed-cycle midpoint with a dated licensing catalyst. Not (c)/(d) on its own.
**What proves us wrong:** FY27 Q1 op margin < 20%; handset revenue still down YoY at flat units; Apple-closure QTL terms below the ~$5.6B run-rate; or FY27 EPS guide < ~$10 at the 11-04 print.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.detail: >=3, observable, current, each citing a filing/IR line
sections.markdown:
1. MediaTek displacement is LIVE and the run is NOT a handset recovery: TTM handset revenue $25.9B is BELOW FY25's $27.79B (10-K segment table) while Android units are growing — a share-loss tell. If the next 10-Q shows handset down YoY at flat units, the opex-pivot + share story is structural and the $10 mid-cycle EPS is unreachable.
2. The freshest financial fact is margin compression, not recovery: Q3 FY26 op margin 16.4% on $9.95B revenue (vs 26.6% / $10.37B a year earlier, FY26 10-Q); revenue fell sequentially Q1→Q3 ($12.25B → $9.95B). The +56%/6m re-rate is guidance-led — two quarters of margin swing must arrive to justify it.
3. The multiple is no longer a discount: at ~$202 the stock trades ~19.8–21.9x forward EPS (trailing EPS ~$8.6) — around my DCF central ~$215, so −18.8% off-high is a re-rate ~60% spent, not a value entry. A 11-04 guide miss unwinds it (date kill).
4. Apple license closure risk: the global license renewal is effective 2027-04-01; if the disclosed QTL terms land below the ~$5.7B run-rate, both the licensing leg and the clarity narrative de-rate (10-K/QTL disclosure, pre-closure).
5. Momentum-crash structure — the archetype's dominant failure: the 6 months already executed a +102% melt-up (April low ~$124) into a ~$250 rejection (May), then ~20% give-back; mom1 +24% is a second push into that rejected zone under a CAUTIOUS post-hike regime (the macro regime memo). The base-rate note counsels holding off in exactly this configuration.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is mid-2027 and this position lost 30%+. The most likely reason: the FY27 EPS recovery did not arrive — op margin stayed below 20% through FY27 Q1 (the kpi kill, not cut), MediaTek kept taking handset share, and the 11-04 guide was soft; with the Fed funded-up and DXY ~101, a ~20x-forward name de-rated as the re-rate reversed. That is the momentum-crash tail, likely gapping through the $158 kill to ~$140 (−26% from entry). Second joint: I chased — bought above $196 into the mom1 spike, so the fill, not the discipline, decided the outcome. **Sizing input to PM:** conviction 3/5 — the variant is real and the dated licensing catalyst is inside the window, but the run is ~60% spent and the entry is the trade (EV +2.0% at ≤$190, ~−4% at the current $202; do not size at market). Liquidity clean: ADV ~$17.8M, days-to-exit trivial. Correlation ~0 to the current GLOBAL card set (no semis sleeve) — genuinely diversifying. Kelly: own +0.24 (p_up .42 / up 26 / down −17) vs library +0.61 (momentum_continuation .50 / +30 / −22) at the given quad — the whole gap is my two deviations: p_up −8pp (CAUTIOUS regime + failed 1-month-reversal filter + earnings-not-yet-delivered) and up_pct −4pp (target trimmed to re-rate completion, not the DCF moon).
